content: Standard SaaS auto-provisioning guidance: use a stable matching attribute (typically verified email domain) to link to an EXISTING tenant/org before creating a new one, especially on first-enable ('day zero'). Treat lifecycle transitions (disconnect, reconnect, soft-delete+restore) as first-class state machine transitions -- ad hoc soft-delete-then-restore is a common cause of duplicate records. Permanent conflicts (duplicate name/slug) should force explicit manual resolution rather than silent duplicate creation.
